fact: COLEPS handles the whole process from tender publication to contract execution monitoring including online bid submission; the 27 December 2024 order makes exclusive electronic award progressively mandatory from 2025 and compulsory from financial year 2027, local authorities included; version 2 of COLEPS was launched 25 June 2025.
title: Dematerialising Public Contracts Procedures : Merits Of E-Procurement System
